recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No core FHIR follow-up is needed for FHIR-31813 unless BR&R later decides to introduce a new extension or other explicit model for specified-substance details.
issue_request: FHIR-31813 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification BR&R issue saying specifiedSubstance was not sufficiently defined and asking, by final resolution, to drop the specifiedSubstance backbone element from Ingredient because current IDMP need was unclear and PQ/CMC was not using it.
initial_application: Jira records that the change was applied in the R4B branch and main build. Git commits 6b369be0a3586b4327b7be45bb93e65c344f66e0 and 5730009f8bc3d8edcbaba2bbf979741b55017c7b removed Ingredient.specifiedSubstance, its specified-substance search parameters, and the specified-substance example, while making Ingredient.substance mandatory.
additional_context: Ingredient is active in the current build and MedicinalProductIngredient redirects to Ingredient. FHIR-31815, FHIR-31816, and FHIR-31876 are the same modeling family; FHIR-31816 and FHIR-31876 already have reconciliation commits on the combined branch, and FHIR-31815 was resolved no-change because the remodeling made its proposed invariant unnecessary. Zulip and BR&R minutes support the conclusion that the approved resolution was model simplification/removal, not a remaining prose clarification.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current Ingredient StructureDefinition has Ingredient.substance as a single 1..1 backbone and no Ingredient.specifiedSubstance or Ingredient.specificSubstance element. Ingredient search parameters, examples, and ModelInfo no longer expose specifiedSubstance surfaces; the remaining "Specified Substance.Strength" string is only an external IDMP mapping label on Ingredient.substance.strength.

related_jiras.note: Resolved - No Change because the same remodeling made the proposed substance/specifiedSubstance mutual-exclusivity rule obsolete.
